usual_baseline: Basic bloods and BP often 70–90%. ECG, prolactin and waist circumference are poor, waist often 0% [3356][3690]. Full monitoring is rare: 0% [3150], 15.15% [3502], 18% [3689], 32% [3304]. Abnormal results are often not acted on: 27 of 32 with dyslipidaemia had no intervention [3211].
fix_that_works: A dedicated pathway or clinic. Junior-led virtual clinic with a phlebotomy/ECG pathway: per-patient compliance 9% to 69% [3257]. Weekly mop-up of outstanding results: 140 outstanding bloods to 24, then 100% by eight weeks [3417]. Screening tool plus GP coordination: 15.15% to 66.67% [3502]. Checklist and education: 29% to 68% [3690]. Ward round template and poster: side-effect monitoring 46.66% to 100% [3499].
fix_that_fails: Recommendations alone in general practice: three or more risk factors monitored rose only from 48% to 60%, and no measure reached 80% [3631]. During COVID 8/10 standards fell [3108]. Repeat ECG stayed below target at 79.17% [3499]. Clinic non-attendance stayed high: DNA 52% to 42% [3426], and 51% attended an on-site clinic [3262].
consultant_advice: Heavily overdone: 39 audits, mostly single cycles with no re-audit, all finding the same gaps. Don't do another measurement audit. Audit whether abnormal results lead to action, such as statins or smoking cessation, or test a dedicated clinic or weekly results mop-up and re-audit it.
